contentText:
Doug OLaughlin / Fabricated Knowledge :

Claude Code represents a “ChatGPT moment repeated” and an “extinction-level event” for horizontal software companies focused on human-oriented consumption   —  The age of PDF is over.  The time of markdown has begun.  Why Memory Hierarchies are the best analogy for how software must change.
